slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize total profit (total revenue minus total processing cost minus total raw material cost) across all products?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and specified maximizing total profit, directly covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only listed P0 hidden slot, the objective, was confirmed before READY_TO_MODEL. No listed P0/P1 slots remained unresolved.

summary: The agent explicitly confirmed the core hidden objective early in the interview and then moved to READY_TO_MODEL with no listed P0/P1 hidden slots unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
